title: aglaia sapindina
intro: Aglaia sapindina, commonly known as the yellow aglaia, is a species of plant in the Meliaceae family. It is native to Southeast Asia and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is believed to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which make it useful in treating various health conditions such as fever, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Aglaia sapindina include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions of analgesia, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
